page.content:
Showtime, Shaq-and-Kobe, and LeBron's West chapter.

How Los Angeles Lakers connects

  • Character: Kobe Bryant — Kobe Bryant spent his entire NBA career with the Lakers.
  • Character: Magic Johnson — Magic Johnson ran the Showtime Los Angeles Lakers.
  • Concept: Celtics–Lakers rivalry — The Lakers half of the rivalry runs from the Minneapolis move through Showtime and Kobe.
  • Topic: NBA — The Los Angeles Lakers are the other pole of the league's central rivalry.
  • Character: Shaquille O'Neal — Shaquille O'Neal was the dominant center of the three-peat Lakers.
  • Character: LeBron James — LeBron James won a title in his Los Angeles Lakers chapter.

What is Los Angeles Lakers?

The Los Angeles Lakers are the other half of the league's central rivalry: Magic's Showtime, Kobe and Shaq, Kobe's late titles, and LeBron James's 2020 championship.

Key threads lead to Kobe Bryant, Magic Johnson, Celtics–Lakers rivalry, NBA, Shaquille O'Neal and LeBron James.
